info.comments: Jarvis - AI Voice Companion. macOS permission strings (NSMicrophoneUsageDescription, NSAppleEventsUsageDescription), LSMinimumSystemVersion=12.0, and LSArchitecturePriority=[arm64] are declared in build/darwin/Info.plist (Wails v2 renders that template into the bundled .app). Hardened-runtime entitlements live at build/darwin/entitlements.plist and are picked up by codesign during `wails build`.
